mechanism_narrative: Lower federal funds rate levels directly reduce the risk-free rate, compressing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in >60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 3.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and compresses valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in >60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
